lastCompletedStory.title: preflight-failed arm in runPostAuditAction with marker write and notify

nextStoryContext: US-003 added a distinct { kind: 'preflight-failed' } member to PostAuditActionResult (src/supervisor/plan-runner.ts) with a new handlePreflightFailed(step, detail, notifyFn, writePreflightFailedMarkerFn) helper (mirrors handlePlanTargetInvalid), wired into runPostAuditAction via an arm placed immediately before the generic 'Non-approved: nothing to do' fall-through. The arm calls writePreflightFailedMarkerFn?.({ step, detail }) with the FULL untruncated detail (writer-params carry ONLY { step, detail }, no writtenAt -- pure/clock-free), then notifyFn?.(`[cam] plan preflight failed: ${step} - ${truncatePreflightDetail(detail)}`) using the US-002 truncatePreflightDetail helper (src/supervisor/plan-preflight-marker.ts). RunPostAuditOptions gained writePreflightFailedMarkerFn?: (params: PlanPreflightFailedWriterParams) => void, optional/no-op-by-default. Production wiring: sidecar.ts adds makeWritePreflightFailedMarkerFn(claudeDir) (stamps writtenAt, mirrors makeWriteEscalationMarkerFn verbatim, writes .claude/.cam-plan-preflight-failed.json via writePlanPreflightFailedMarker) and threads it into runPostPlanActions's runPostAuditAction call. exitPhaseAfterPlan (sidecar.ts) needed ZERO changes: its existing fallback (`kind === 'branch-created' ? return : setPhase(kind === 'awaiting-operator-approval' ? 'awaiting-operator' : 'idle')`) already routes the new 'preflight-failed' kind to idle -- proved via the existing 'B: exitPhaseAfterPlan transitions to idle on no-action/escalated outcomes' source-regex test plus the new preflight-failed test block in plan-runner-postaudit.test.ts. The existing plan-preflight-failed EVENT write inside runPlanPhase (plan-runner.ts:755, kind: 'plan-preflight-failed' via logEvent) is UNTOUCHED -- this story only adds the marker+notify one layer up in runPostAuditAction, on the DIFFERENT PlanPhaseResult.kind === 'preflight-failed' terminal that runPlanPhase already returns (step/detail fields pre-existing on that union member, no change needed there). Two PRE-EXISTING tests in plan-runner-postaudit.test.ts that asserted PREFLIGHT_FAILED_RESULT -> { kind: 'no-action' } were updated to assert the new distinct 'preflight-failed' kind (this was an intentional, PRD-mandated behavior change, not a regression). File-size budget raised: src/supervisor/plan-runner.ts 1174->1228, src/commands/sidecar.ts 2280->2301 (tracker ref CAM-215 in the _ref diff). US-004 is next (marker REMOVAL, Option B: remove on ANY non-preflight-failed plan result, NOT gated on issueId -- unlike removeEscalationMarkerFn's convergence-gated removal precedent at plan-runner.ts's proceed-branch path) -- the removal call should be wired analogously to removeEscalationMarkerFn (called only on the audit-approved -> branch-created convergence path in the current code), but re-read the US-004 PRD note carefully since Option B says ANY non-preflight-failed result, which is broader than just the proceed-branch path; removePlanPreflightFailedMarker(filePath) already exists in src/supervisor/plan-preflight-marker.ts (US-002) and just needs a production call site + a seam in RunPostAuditOptions, following the exact optional-seam-with-no-op-default pattern used for writePreflightFailedMarkerFn/removeEscalationMarkerFn in this story.
